scene.title: Why Triangle Angles Add to 180°
scene.summary: By drawing a line parallel to one side through the opposite vertex, alternate interior angles show that the three angles form a straight line of 180°.

beats.title: Start with any triangle
beats.narration: Consider triangle ABC with three interior angles at its vertices.

beats.title: Label the three angles
beats.narration: Let the interior angles at vertices A, B, and C be α, β, and γ.

beats.title: Draw a parallel line
beats.narration: Draw a straight line through vertex C that is parallel to the base AB.

check.question: When a line crosses two parallel lines, what is true about alternate interior angles?
check.explain: Alternate interior angles formed by a transversal across parallel lines are always equal.

beats.title: Identify alternate interior angles
beats.narration: Because the line is parallel to AB, alternate interior angles reveal α and β at vertex C.

beats.title: Angles form a straight line
beats.narration: Angles α, γ, and β sit side by side along a straight line, proving their sum is 180°.
